Here's a few general tips. In addition, we strongly recommend using [QGIS User Manual](https://docs.qgis.org/3.40/en/docs/user_manual/index.html)

## Keyboard Shortcuts

Change the below to QGIS things like F7 for Style Manager and CTRL + . for digitising

| Code | Hotkey | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Run current line (when in Script) |
| `<-` | <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>-</kbd> | Assignment |
| `%>%` | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> | Pipe |
|  | <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Cancel current operation (when in Console) |
|  | <kbd>F1</kbd> | Help documentation for selected function |
